<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-03-1209-26-28" status="unreviewed"><milestone n="Abhidharmasamuccaya lineage" unit="section"/>
            yang brang ti nas 'chims brtson seng | rgyang ro dar ma mgon | mchims brtson rgyal | shong blo brtan | lo tsA ba mchog ldan | dpang lo tsA ba | byang rtse | nya dbon po kun dga' dpal | chos dpal mgon po | bdag nyid chen po blo gros rgya mtsho'i bar ro || 
            yang | ko bo ye shes 'byung gnas | 'ban | tho gar ba gcam lde | 'jad pa byang skyabs | 'jad pa gzhon byang | 'bring mtshams zhang | bo dong rin rtse | khro phu rin po che bsod nams seng ge | tshad ma'i skyes bu | bu ston rin po che | mkhan chen dharma shrI | 
            des dbus su sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la gsungs so ||</seg></TEI>
